title: Two-Step Extraction of a Pair
statement: Let $first,second\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ and let Boolean words satisfy $x=pre\mathbin{++}[b,c]\mathbin{++}rest$. Starting from the extractor configuration at position $|pre|$ with state indicating that it is ready to read the first symbol, tape word $a$, head at $|a|$, and empty output, after two steps the configuration is at position $|pre|+2$ with tape word and head position unchanged and empty output if $b=c$; if $b\ne c$ and $b$ is true, it is halted with those same tape and output contents; if $b$ is false, it is in state $0$ with tape word $a$, head position $|a|-1$ (truncated at zero), and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: first and second are Boolean flags
x, pre, rest, and a are Boolean words
